name: Quiet Anime Poetry
description: Cinematic hand-drawn anime with delicate ink contours, restrained cel shading, muted teal-blue-green palette, and contemplative atmosphere.
style_bible: Cinematic hand-drawn anime illustration with delicate, confident ink contours and restrained clean cel shading. Where figures appear, draw them with natural adult proportions and simple readable silhouettes, set against softly painted, spatially convincing environments. Use smooth gradients where the scene provides open air, reflective surfaces or light, a pristine digital finish and carefully controlled environmental detail; avoid grain and distressed surface texture. Build colour around muted teal, deep blue and deep green, balanced by selective amber, dusty peach or cream highlights. Light is soft and directional, with luminous open passages and subtle rim light; keep shadow shapes rich but legible. Convey feeling through understated posture, meaningful spatial relationships and the surrounding atmosphere. Choose scene-specific visual metaphors for the underlying feeling rather than illustrating every spoken sentence literally. Compose original, elegant frames with layered depth, asymmetrical balance and uncluttered breathing room. Preserve quiet intimacy, contemplation and emotional ambiguity without theatrical expressions. Adapt time of day, setting, subject and palette balance to each scene instead of repeating a fixed motif. Artwork contains no text; captions are rendered separately.
negative_prompt: film grain, sensor noise, halftone, stippling, distressed paper, grunge, heavy canvas texture, rough dry-brush surface, muddy shadows, oversaturated neon, harsh glossy 3D rendering, photorealistic skin, chibi proportions, exaggerated facial expressions, malformed anatomy, extra fingers, lettering, captions, logos, watermarks
